assumptions.meaning: The original source-attestation, stable-source, logical terminal authority, current-use and durable-call assumptions are retained.
The equivalence covers finite distinct credited roots and holders, supported positive canonical ordinary effects, and the supplied current contexts. It is not realization under every fixed policy.
The historical projection covers the declared observed and sourced request and environment alphabets, preserving the full current state and raw histories.
The original exact current-source and replica checks execute before projection. Block inputs contain structured HOL entries, not a byte encoding of arbitrary function-valued state.

Authentic current policy, physical source control, distributed agreement, atomic durable effect/results, complete current recovery inputs and compiled consumers require separate implementation evidence.
